dedupe_keys.name: global gridded gdp consistent with the shared socioeconomic pathways 2005 2030 to 2100

description: This dataset gives spatially explicit gross domestic product grids for the present and for future scenarios, a common exposure input for infrastructure damage and risk models. It covers the globe from 60 degrees south at 30 arc-seconds and 0.25 degrees, for 2005 and for 2030 to 2100 at 10-year intervals under all five SSPs, in 2005 PPP US dollars, disaggregated with a LitPop map built from DMSP-OLS night lights and LandScan population and gross regional product of over 800 provinces, and accounting for China's two-child policy. It was produced by T. Wang and F. Sun of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and described in Scientific Data in May 2022. The GeoTIFF files, about 6.9 GB, are available for free download from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: growth is uniform within administrative units, the night-light image is fixed, and unlit or unpopulated areas are set to zero. It supports future economic exposure scenarios for infrastructure hazard and adaptation studies; a related record is the LandScan population datasets.
name: Global gridded GDP consistent with the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (2005, 2030 to 2100)
